principles: Film chronology/outcomes remain immutable; optional gameplay fills safe gaps only.
A red critical exact-head gate blocks unrelated feature expansion until repaired.
Player agency should not be removed longer than the presentation actually requires.
Automatic persistence during active play should avoid avoidable disk hitches.
Developer navigation must not ship as ordinary player controls.
Repeated environment detail should prefer instancing/culling over actor proliferation.
Hot-path actor enumeration and synchronous loads require measurement and explicit ownership.
Machine success never substitutes for rendered PIE/device/human acceptance.

findings.title: World material persistence is unreliable
findings.evidence: Unreal #594 on 38c2c958121576b68a0bfaf4e276498d4fe89dad passed UE4.27.2 C++ build, deterministic production import, Automation, startup and P1C01-P1C08. M_ProductionSurface was resident and CharacterSurfaceAudit passed. The workflow then failed in the persistence state gate, so the final warning-debt/material-persistence step remained skipped.
findings.action: Complete the persistence repair on a fresh exact head, then require the warning-debt/material-persistence gate to execute. Do not add another material recovery path unless that gate identifies a concrete package defect.

findings.title: Cinematic mode could lock movement for up to 27 seconds
findings.evidence: Presentation durations include RingWarning=27s while current camera framing is only a few seconds.
findings.action: Cap lightweight presentation input lock at 3.5s while dialogue/audio continue.

findings.title: Developer chapter/route controls were bound in all builds
findings.evidence: F6/F7/F8 debug navigation bindings were unconditional.
findings.action: Bind developer chapter/route controls only in non-shipping builds.

findings.title: Automatic checkpoints used synchronous disk writes during active gameplay
findings.evidence: Story-triggered SaveAutomaticCheckpoint used SaveGameToSlot.
findings.action: Use queued AsyncSaveGameToSlot for automatic checkpoints; keep CI disk roundtrip deterministic.

findings.title: NPC social pairing uses distributed actor iteration
findings.evidence: Ambient NPCs perform two TActorIterator scans and named companion banter performs another.
findings.action: Profile target-device game-thread cost; move candidate lookup to a central registry/director if cost becomes material.

findings.title: Chapter builders perform many direct LoadObject calls
findings.evidence: All inspected non-engine runtime LoadObject paths have been removed from the current branch: chapter world builders now resolve only asynchronously resident bank assets; player/named-NPC/enemy production visuals use resident soft resolution; ShireAudioSubsystem no longer LoadObject<USoundBase>. Remaining direct LoadObject calls are limited to tiny /Engine/BasicShapes fallback assets and are guarded by deep_project_audit.py.
findings.action: Fresh Pre-Unreal must pass, then runner recovery must provide UE4.27 compile/import/startup/transition evidence. Measure transition hitch and resident memory before closing performance acceptance.

findings.title: Ambient living-world actors use spawn/cull/destroy churn
findings.evidence: LivingWorldDirector now owns bounded ambient-NPC reuse and AShireAmbientNPC deactivation disables tick/visibility/collision and clears social state. Destroy paths remain for non-pooled/excess/event actors, so target-device Spawn/Destroy/GC measurement is still required.
findings.action: Do not increase population because pooling exists. Validate exact head and measure churn/GC on target hardware; extend pooling only to proven hot ephemeral classes while keeping named persistent NPC identity out of the pool.

findings.title: Chapter router scans world actors during teardown
findings.evidence: GetAllActorsOfClass is used at chapter rebuild, not every frame.
findings.action: Accept at current scale; migrate to owned generated-actor registries if teardown cost grows.

findings.title: Save/route validation performs real isolated disk roundtrip
findings.evidence: Current CI mutates, writes, loads, verifies and deletes a unique save slot.
findings.action: Preserve this evidence path.

findings.title: NPC context can advance to destination story/world context before visible world commit
findings.evidence: ChapterWorldRouter now publishes committed chapter/route/episode/revision plus committed quest snapshot to UShireNPCContextSubsystem on normal commit and rollback. Regional mood/profile availability use committed identity; danger uses live quest only while logical and committed world identities match; new bounded dialogue/film-context selection is suppressed during the async mismatch window.
findings.action: After runner recovery, execute a forced slow transition and assert that old-world NPCs never expose destination mood/dialogue before OnWorldCommitted, while same-world quest-stage reactions still update.

findings.title: Character rig async handles can accumulate for the full GameInstance lifetime
findings.evidence: Character rigs use async soft paths; completed handles release after actor-owned handoff; requests now call FPackageName::DoesPackageExist for mesh+AnimBP packages once per GameInstance and do not RequestAsyncLoad absent future-production packages. This removes the missing-package engine error flood seen in Build #547 while preserving modular fallback.
findings.action: Fresh exact-head compile/runtime proof, then multi-chapter memory/GC measurement once real skeletal FBX rigs exist.

findings.title: Chapter spawn coordinates could drift onto collision seams
findings.evidence: Unreal #594 on 38c2c958121576b68a0bfaf4e276498d4fe89dad executed the aggregate P1C01-P1C08 chapter sweep with attempted=8 expected=8 failed=[]; the former P1C05 no-blocking-ground symptom did not recur.
findings.action: Keep the shared bounded grounding invariant and no-support-pad guard. Later confirm the original traversal symptom in rendered PIE/device review before final visual/traversal acceptance.

findings.title: Chapter runtime CI hid later failures by stopping at the first red chapter
findings.evidence: Unreal #594 completed all eight chapter audits in one run and emitted RUNTIME_SWEEP_SUMMARY with failed=[].
findings.action: Preserve the non-fail-fast aggregate sweep as a permanent regression guard.

findings.title: Legacy texture format and duplicate OBJ face vertices created avoidable import debt
findings.evidence: Unreal #595 passed the full required runtime chain on a148d1afa919fa63725e3760684d6eed061c5e40, but import logs still contained 137 unique nearly-zero binormal identities and corresponding tangent warnings. Pre-Unreal source audit also reported 321/352 OBJ files without UVs and 334/352 without explicit normals. The old warning guard allowed up to 150, which could hide persistent quality debt.
findings.action: Importer working-copy normalization now generates deterministic face-projected UVs for OBJ files lacking vt records and package-existence preflights M_ProductionSurface before any synchronous load attempt. Tangent/binormal/master-surface warning ceilings are now zero. Fresh exact-head compile/import must prove the normalizer removes the warning class rather than merely tolerating it.

findings.title: Save restore published quest identity before all persistent domains were rebuilt
findings.evidence: RestoreSaveSnapshot called RestoreQuestState first; that method immediately broadcast route/chapter/quest events before NPC memory, discoveries, progression and map/chronicle knowledge were restored. Unreal #594 also showed disk write/load/restore succeeded but final verification failed without field-level diagnostics.
findings.action: Use BeginPersistenceRestore/CommitPersistenceRestore so all logical domains rebuild before one publication boundary; rollback publishes only after old geometry/player placement is rebuilt. State CI now reports exact failed persistence fields and seeds real NPC memory.

findings.title: Already-resident chapter bank could cause a false asset-commit failure
findings.evidence: RequestChapterAssets returns OnChapterAssetsReady immediately for an already-resident chapter/route after cancelling pending state, but CommitPendingRequest previously required matching PendingChapterId/PendingRouteId. Same-bank episode/save transitions could therefore roll back despite valid residency.
findings.action: CommitPendingRequest now accepts an already-resident matching bank and republishes the residency-commit signal. Add exact-head same-bank transition coverage.

findings.title: Cancelled asynchronous audio callbacks could still execute stale playback
findings.evidence: CancelPendingAudioCategory removed/cancelled handles, but HandleAsyncAudioReady did not verify that LoadKey was still owned before resolving/playing the completed request.
findings.action: Late callbacks now return unless PendingAudioLoads still owns LoadKey. Keep audio runtime acceptance separate because CI currently runs with -NoSound.

findings.title: Import warning ceilings allowed large tangent/binormal debt to remain green
findings.evidence: Unreal #601 reduced runtime warning debt to three meshes, but Pre-Unreal #768's newly strengthened source audit exposed the same structural class across 23 additional project-owned static OBJ assets: degenerate UV triangles in 23 assets and opposed authored normals in 7 of them. The standalone asset-quality CI step was still non-strict, so it printed ERROR lines yet returned success.
findings.action: Normalize all 23 exposed static OBJ sources to explicit triangulated face-local UV/normal bases, keep zero warning ceilings, and make the Pre-Unreal asset-quality workflow run with --strict so source structural errors cannot be advisory.

findings.title: Gameplay mutation could occur while destination quest state was ahead of committed world geometry
findings.evidence: ChapterWorldRouter held CharacterMovement during async swaps, but player interaction/combat/supplies/save paths and trigger/puzzle/world-interaction actors did not share the same transaction barrier. A transition therefore had a window where logical destination state could exist while old geometry was still committed.
findings.action: Mirror ChapterWorldRouter world hold into AShirePlayerCharacter; require IsGameplayWorldCommitted() on physical gameplay mutation paths; require committed logical context for named NPC banter; assert the barrier in continuous transition runtime audit.

findings.title: UE4.27 package-name overload ambiguity blocked the stricter importer wave
findings.evidence: Unreal #601 on 34a9a2a8b2cf8f944ce4eae7e90fc7492809b9ab completed UE4.27.2 C++ build successfully, proving the explicit FString ObjectPathToPackageName fix compiles on the target engine.
findings.action: Pass an explicit FString to ObjectPathToPackageName and preserve PG-131 static guard so automated edits cannot reintroduce the ambiguous call.

findings.title: Legacy save repair could publish and commit an intermediate world identity
findings.evidence: CommitPersistenceRestore cleared bPersistenceRestoreInProgress and broadcast experience/chapter/quest state before OnQuestStateRestored. ShireStoryFlowSubsystem repairs terminal legacy saves from OnQuestStateRestored using StartChapter/StartExperience, so an already-resident bank could commit the pre-repair identity before the repair fired. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Run the repair hook while persistence broadcast suppression is still active; suppress StartQuest/StartChapter/StartExperience broadcasts during restore; skip route-progress recapture while restoring; publish only the final repaired identity.

findings.title: Synchronous same-bank restore commit could capture stale player-life state
findings.evidence: RestoreSaveSnapshot published the restored logical identity before assigning player health/stamina/resolve/supplies. An already-resident chapter bank can commit synchronously from the final identity broadcast and CaptureCommittedRollbackSnapshot immediately. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Restore player-life fields before CommitPersistenceRestore(true), so any synchronous world commit/rollback snapshot observes a complete restored player + quest state.

findings.title: Committed NPC context query was private while named NPC runtime called it
findings.evidence: Unreal #601 completed UE4.27.2 C++ build successfully on 34a9a2a8b2cf8f944ce4eae7e90fc7492809b9ab, so the public read-only NPC committed-context API compiles with named NPC consumers.
findings.action: Promote the read-only committed-context query to the public NPCContext API, keep mutation ownership private, and add PG-133/deep-audit visibility guards.

findings.title: World mutation hold started after preload instead of at logical destination request
findings.evidence: Source simulation of ChapterWorldRouter showed LoadChapterWorld assigned pending destination and requested async assets without SetPlayerWorldHold(true). PG-131 runtime expected held-during-swap, but the authoritative hold was only guaranteed later in CommitChapterWorld. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Raise the hold before pending destination/preload, release only when rapid A->pending B->A cancellation proves the exact old world is committed, and require one runtime marker to prove both pending hold and cancel release.

findings.title: Async checkpoint completion could heal a different committed world
findings.evidence: HandleCheckpointSaveComplete applied full health/stamina/resolve on any successful callback. Async disk I/O can finish after a chapter/world revision changes, allowing an old checkpoint callback to mutate destination player state. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Capture chapter/route/episode/world revision when the async save is scheduled. Keep the disk result valid, but apply checkpoint heal/HUD effects only if callback origin still matches the exact committed world.

findings.title: NPC memory pruning occurred at logical chapter request before world commit
findings.evidence: StartChapter called PruneNPCMemoryForCurrentChapter before destination geometry/residency commit. Rollback snapshots could repair this later, but live persistent state was destructively aged during the uncommitted window and restore canonicalization could prune against an intermediate chapter. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Move destructive memory aging to CommitWorldBoundState called by ChapterWorldRouter only after destination world/context commit; suppress restore pruning until the final canonical commit.

findings.title: Ambient social check scanned the full ambient actor set twice
findings.evidence: AShireAmbientNPC::UpdateSocialLife used two TActorIterator<AShireAmbientNPC> traversals per social check: one for active-social count and one for nearest partner selection.
findings.action: Use one bounded traversal for both results. Keep target-device profiling as the acceptance boundary; no FPS claim is made from source inspection.

findings.title: Three procedural OBJ assets carried invalid tangent-space source data
findings.evidence: Unreal #601 zero-warning gate isolated nearly-zero tangent/binormal debt to SM_Balrog_Wing, SM_Lurtz_Blade and SM_Isengard_IndustrialPitRim. Source geometry analysis found 4 zero-area UV triangles in each of the first two meshes and widespread authored normal/face opposition in the industrial rim. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Use face-local non-degenerate UV triangles and face-aligned normals for these flat-color procedural meshes. asset_quality_audit.py now rejects future degenerate UV triangles and strongly opposed authored normals before engine import.

findings.title: Asset-quality CI printed structural ERROR lines without failing
findings.evidence: Pre-Unreal #768 showed the asset-quality step as SUCCESS even while its log printed structural ERROR lines for 23 degenerate-UV assets and 7 opposed-normal assets because the workflow invoked asset_quality_audit.py without --strict. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Run asset_quality_audit.py --strict in Pre-Unreal and add both pre_unreal_validate and deep_project_audit guards that fail if the workflow loses strict mode.

findings.title: Tangent-basis debt existed beyond the three meshes visible in Unreal #601
findings.evidence: The generic source audit exposed 23 additional static OBJ assets with degenerate UV triangles and 7 with opposed normals, including Balrog/Lurtz proxy pieces, Watcher tentacle, Isengard industrial props and Shire props. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Normalize the full exposed set in one wave rather than waiting for Unreal to surface one warning identity at a time. Preserve the skeletal-FBX-only rule for final animated assets.

findings.title: Queued automatic checkpoint was reconstructed from later live world state
findings.evidence: SaveAutomaticCheckpoint queued only QueuedCheckpointSaveId while another save was in flight. HandleCheckpointSaveComplete later called SaveAutomaticCheckpoint(NextId), causing CreateSaveSnapshot to run against the then-current world. A transition between the two writes could serialize destination state under an old checkpoint ID or drop the queued checkpoint while the world hold was active. Exact head ddd0957d6201c8bf553825acd671c98a9be545ef completed Unreal #605 compile/import/Automation/startup/P1C01-P1C08/state/transitions and zero-warning debt successfully.
findings.action: Capture and UPROPERTY-own the queued UShireSaveGame snapshot plus chapter/route/episode/world revision at request time. Dispatch that captured snapshot directly after the active write completes; never reconstruct it from later live state. Keep completion side effects origin-bound.

findings.title: Rollback snapshot freshness was tied to the last world commit instead of the transition request
findings.evidence: Source simulation after the fully green Unreal #605 path showed CaptureCommittedRollbackSnapshot was called at world commit/rollback completion, but no pre-mutation transition boundary refreshed it immediately before a later StartChapter/StartExperience request. Player-life, quest, discovery or NPC-memory changes made since the prior world commit could therefore be lost if the next swap failed.
findings.action: Publish OnWorldTransitionRequested before logical chapter/route mutation, have ChapterWorldRouter capture a snapshot only from an exact committed origin, then raise the transaction hold. Exercise a failure after distinct live player-state mutation and require exact origin restoration.

findings.title: Unsupported chapter/route rejection could leave an invalid logical destination without atomic rollback
findings.evidence: The previous CommitChapterWorld unsupported branch cancelled pending streaming, cleared pending IDs and returned. It did not restore the prior quest/world snapshot or guarantee movement release, so an invalid destination request could leave logical and physical world state split.
findings.action: Make supported route/chapter pairs explicit and route every unsupported destination through RollbackFailedWorldSwap. CI fault mode intentionally requests P1C99 and requires restored identity, movement, player state, NPC context and LivingWorld revision.

external_practice_alignment.basis: Epic UE4.27 recommends AsyncSaveGameToSlot for active-play saves.

external_practice_alignment.project_action: V5 chapter/route soft-path async preload is implemented as a guarded source/runtime mitigation; exact-head engine proof and target-device measurement remain required before performance promotion.
external_practice_alignment.basis: Epic recommends soft references/asynchronous loading to reduce stalls and memory pressure.

external_practice_alignment.project_action: retain/expand instancing for repeated non-interactive detail
external_practice_alignment.basis: Unreal instancing reduces repeated actor/object/draw-call cost.
UE4 performance guidance emphasizes profiling actual target workloads.
